families.fixed_nondetection: No reviewed shipped asset directly binds James session state to a named memory-store/carrier object.

state_projection.R0: Within the actually reviewed shipped-asset subset, the source may state the scoped nondetection it observed.
state_projection.R1: SOURCE_RULE_COUNTERFACTUAL: if coverage were claim-matched but the relevant binding detector/sensitivity remained uncertain, absence remains unresolved.
state_projection.R2: Observed: broader James-specific storage absence is NOT_ESTABLISHED and a wider backend/session/carrier audit is required.

families.fixed_nondetection: No novelty-masked TT/TNT local motif met the frozen HT-screen eligibility thresholds.

state_projection.R0: Observed: VALID_NEGATIVE_FOR_TESTED_ONTOLOGY within the frozen local TT/TNT motif and frequency universe.
state_projection.R1: SOURCE_RULE_COUNTERFACTUAL: a searched local universe with inadequate/unknown sensitivity would not admit a negative even inside that scope.
state_projection.R2: Observed boundary: the local negative does not prove absence of longer or differently conditioned Linear A formula structure.

families.fixed_nondetection: Exact older teddy/bear literal was not recovered in the named current repository/library/archive searches.

state_projection.R0: Observed: NOT_RECOVERED_IN_CURRENT_REPOSITORY_AND_LIBRARY_SEARCH is admissible as a scoped search result.
state_projection.R1: SOURCE_RULE_COUNTERFACTUAL: if search coverage matched a declared corpus but retrieval sensitivity were uncertain, absence would remain unresolved.
state_projection.R2: Observed: the source does not infer that an older teddy artifact never existed; future recovery remains admissible and append-only.

families.fixed_nondetection: Public primary evidence did not resolve participant overlap/non-overlap or separate direct per-trial baseline data.

state_projection.R0: Observed: public-search insufficiency can be stated inside the public-evidence scope.
state_projection.R1: SOURCE_RULE_COUNTERFACTUAL: even claim-matched coverage with inadequate sensitivity cannot justify an absence claim.
state_projection.R2: Observed: PUBLIC_SEARCH_EXHAUSTION_NE_NEGATIVE_PROOF_OF_OVERLAP; author-level/controlled evidence is required before the biological relation may be resolved.

destructive_null.operator: Within each family, hold source, nondetection text, and the three coverage states fixed; enumerate all 3! assignments of the three verdict labels to the three coverage states.
destructive_null.real_score: fraction of R0/R1/R2 states receiving their preregistered verdict
